name: Sprout
description: Children in their formative years — needing nurturing, guidance, education support and a safe environment to grow.

registrationFields.label: How can Sprout serve your family?

programs.name: Sprout Club
programs.blurb: Weekly children's activities: games, crafts and stories.
programs.detail: Every Saturday morning children gather for games, crafts, music and stories that build character and confidence. Volunteers lead small groups by age so every child is known and celebrated.

programs.name: Reading Circle
programs.detail: Children read aloud in small circles, earn reading badges and take home books each week to build a lifelong love of reading.

programs.name: Sprout Sports
programs.detail: Fun weekend sport sessions — soccer, netball and movement games — where children learn teamwork and stay active.

programs.name: Creative Arts
programs.detail: Rotating workshops in drawing, singing and drama, ending each term with a showcase for parents.

programs.name: School Support
programs.detail: We help with uniforms, stationery and school fees so no child misses school. Requests are reviewed by the club facilitator and matched with sponsors.

programs.name: Nutrition Program
programs.blurb: Healthy meals and snacks during programs.
programs.detail: Every program serves a healthy meal or snack, and families can join the monthly food parcel list.

programs.name: Holiday Club
programs.detail: Full-day holiday programs with themed activities, outings and guest speakers — safe, fun and free.

programs.name: Sprout Camp
programs.detail: An overnight camp experience with hikes, campfires and team challenges, subsidised so every child can attend.

programs.name: Character Building
programs.blurb: Life skills, values and confidence workshops.
programs.detail: Short workshops on honesty, courage, kindness and confidence — the soft skills school doesn't teach.

name: Surge
description: Young people stepping into adulthood — needing guidance, skills and purpose.
mission: To empower teenagers and young adults with foundational identity, essential life skills, and academic support to successfully transition into independent adulthood.
vision: A generation of confident, purpose-driven young leaders securely anchored in their faith and practically equipped for the future marketplace.

registrationFields.label: What do you want to build this year?

programs.name: The Launch Pad
programs.blurb: Career exposure, internships and job placements.
programs.detail: Work-shadow days, internship placements and CV clinics that open doors into the working world.

programs.name: Life Skills Workshops
programs.blurb: Finance, CV writing and interview prep.
programs.detail: Hands-on workshops — open your first bank account, write a CV that gets read, and nail the interview.

programs.name: Tuition Support
programs.detail: Registration and tuition support for students who qualify, based on need and school reports.

programs.name: School Supply Drive
programs.detail: Annual drive collecting packs of stationery, uniforms and set-work books before each school year starts.

programs.name: Surge Fire
programs.detail: Monthly worship nights with music, testimony and prayer — optional and open to everyone.

programs.name: Purpose Quest
programs.detail: A guided journey through identity, gifts and calling to help you find your purpose.

programs.name: Surge Outings
programs.detail: Regular outings to parks, the beach and local attractions — friendship and fresh air.

programs.name: Impact Squad
programs.detail: Serve alongside your crew on local projects — food drives, clean-ups and outreach in the neighbourhood.

name: Pulse
description: Young adults building careers, finances and identity — needing network and direction.
mission: To equip young professionals and entrepreneurs with cutting-edge marketplace tools, long-term financial mastery, deep accountability networks, and an active marketplace calling.
vision: A thriving network of young adults driving economic innovation and spiritual transformation within their specific corporate and civic industries.

programs.name: The Hustle Hub
programs.detail: Free co-working days plus a 12-week incubator for young businesses — mentorship, templates and pitch practice.

programs.name: Pulse Wallet
programs.detail: A practical money course: budgeting that works, debt and credit scores, and first steps into investing.

programs.name: Career Workshops
programs.blurb: CV writing, interviews and career planning.
programs.detail: Bring your CV, leave with a plan — writing labs, mock interviews and career mapping sessions.

programs.name: Tuition & Study Grants
programs.detail: Short-course and further-study grants awarded each term based on need and a simple application.

programs.detail: Optional weekly prayer groups and Bible studies for those who want to grow spiritually.

programs.name: Pulse Check
programs.detail: Confidential peer circles facilitated by trained volunteers — because your mind matters as much as your money.

programs.name: Social Mixers
programs.detail: Relaxed potlucks, park braais and game evenings — community without the pressure.

programs.name: Purpose in Action
programs.detail: Team up with your crew on a local project each quarter — plan it, run it and see the difference it makes.

name: Prime
description: Mature singles thriving independently — needing community and purpose.
mission: To provide mature single adults with premium spaces for advanced career pivot planning, deep theological sanctuary, exceptional lifestyle networks, and multi-generational mentorship paths.
vision: A leadership powerhouse of mature single professionals living integrated, influential lives while actively funding and mentoring the next generation.

programs.name: Prime Pursuit
programs.detail: Structured programmes for career pivots — new skills, new industries, new confidence.

programs.name: Career Transition Help
programs.blurb: Job search, side hustle and retirement planning.
programs.detail: Practical help with job searches, starting a side hustle or planning a dignified retirement.

helpFields.label: What do you need help with?

programs.name: Retirement & Estate Planning
programs.detail: Plan a dignified retirement and put an estate in order — wills, beneficiaries and wealth that outlives you.

programs.name: Prime Reflection
programs.detail: Optional guided retreats to review the story so far and set direction for what's next.

programs.name: Prayer Shield
programs.detail: Optional teams that pray weekly for members' needs and celebrate answered prayer.

programs.name: Crisis Support
programs.detail: When life happens — emergency financial, food or counselling support assessed case by case.

programs.name: Prime Outings
programs.blurb: Scenic hikes, vineyard lunches and weekend escapes.

programs.name: Legacy Lab
programs.blurb: Mentorship training to give back to younger groups.
programs.detail: Become a trained mentor to Surge and Pulse members — turn your experience into someone else's shortcut.

programs.name: Elders' Table
programs.detail: Quarterly dinners where stories and wisdom are passed between generations.

name: Anchor
description: Single parents raising children alone — needing support, community and practical help.
mission: To alleviate economic stress, cultivate deep personal restoration, and form healthy mutual-aid networks that stabilize whole homes.
vision: A community where single parents transition from surviving to thriving, raising whole families while fulfilling their career and spiritual callings.

registrationFields.label: What support would help most right now?

programs.name: Single-Income Wealth
programs.blurb: Budgeting, debt elimination and property investing.
programs.detail: Build a money structure that works on one income — a budget, a debt-elimination plan and a first step into property.

programs.name: Childcare & Tuition Grants
programs.blurb: Childcare, school fees and study support.
programs.detail: Grants toward childcare, school fees and uniforms so money never decides whether your child gets to learn.

programs.name: Flexible Career Path
programs.blurb: Career progression built around family life.
programs.detail: Coaching on hours, roles and study options that move your career forward without breaking the family rhythm.

programs.name: Restoration Circles
programs.blurb: Co-parenting limits, burnout care and identity tracking.
programs.detail: Small groups that hold the hard parts — co-parenting boundaries, burnout care and remembering who you are.

programs.name: Shield of Grace
programs.detail: A parent fellowship that prays for one another and shows up with a meal or a hand when a week goes sideways.

programs.name: Emergency Cash Relief
programs.blurb: Rapid help when a month goes wrong.
programs.detail: Fast, dignified cash relief for the emergencies that would otherwise blow up the whole month.

programs.name: Parent & Child Outings
programs.blurb: Curated outings for parents and children.
programs.detail: Subsidised days out where you can simply enjoy your kids — memory-making without the cost.

programs.name: Weekend Family Escapes
programs.blurb: Restorative weekends with childcare built in.
programs.detail: Restorative weekend getaways with a childcare grid built in, so parents actually get to rest.

programs.name: Resource Swap
programs.detail: A cooperative database for swapping uniforms and outgrown clothing — what your child has outgrown, another family needs.

mission: To anchor newly married couples with unified financial blueprints, foundational communication tools, and Christ-centered relational habits to construct an unshakeable marital bedrock.
vision: A generation of newly married teams navigating unified asset creation and deep emotional alignment, serving as an unshakeable nucleus for their future children.

programs.detail: Sit down together and build the shared money plan — income, goals and the first assets you create as a team.

programs.name: First Home Blueprint
programs.detail: From deposit to handover — strategies for buying your first home and getting the asset column started.

programs.name: Dual-Career Charting
programs.detail: Chart both careers on one timeline — study, moves, timing and the trade-offs you agree on early.

programs.name: Intimacy Preservation Circles

programs.name: Couples Devotionals
